title: Chailak
summary: Fight Chailak with the Flawless Experimental Battlelords.
overview: Every three seconds during combat, Chailak calls idle Flawless Experimental Battlelords onto a random member of his hate list. Prepare for the linked enemies together.
After five minutes out of combat, Chailak heals fully, removes his buffs, returns home and clears hate. The Battlelords receive the same reset signal.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Assign coverage for Battlelords before engaging Chailak.
